svg.title: How an issue becomes a good first issue
svg.desc: Where labels.toml has labels of the group contribution, the AI says in its first analysis whether someone new to the project could take the issue, with its reason. The script keeps that only with a file that exists among the references, nothing missing, no duplicate and no security report, and records it in the hidden marker of the analysis, so the comment reads the same and no label changes. Once a maintainer has opened or triaged the issue, the digest of the morning names it as a candidate, for 30 days from the analysis at most. The maintainer decides. Adding the label good first issue settles it, GitHub then lists the issue for newcomers, and the quality counts it as kept. A thumbs down on the analysis, or removing the label again, takes it off the list, and the quality counts it as removed.
